description: Reported by the fz-8c session (fz-ep5.2 builder, stack base 62d660974): def kind([h | _]) when h in [:ok, :err], do: 2 fails to compile with error[lower/unsupported]: compiler2 entry guards for kind/1 are not dispatch-pure and cannot be planned. The equivalent when h == :ok or h == :err works on interp. Elixir accepts in with a literal list in any guard. Not checked: receive and case guards. Not yet reproduced in this session.
title: A function-head guard using 'in' with a literal list compiles
